full_judgment: 13. Under Section 95A and 96(10)(d) of the E.B.S.A&T Act, 1950 there is no scope to accept mechanically the agreement and sale deed together to institute a mortgage without excluding the possibilities of creating a post date agreement to defeat the right of the parties concern. In the instant case as I have come across from the case record that a pest date agreement for re-conveyance has set forth from the side of the defendants to frustrate the ease of the plaintiffs. The learned appellate court below rightly held that the deed of agreement for reconveyance is nothing but a manipulated spurious paper in consultation with the evidence on record.
